title: Million Dollar Weekend: The Surprisingly Simple Way to Launch a 7-Figure Business in 48 Hours
author: Noah Kagan
engineRationale: Noah Kagan's core premise is that entrepreneurship is not an intellectual business-planning exercise, but an emotional desensitization sprint against rejection. The relatable subject is the everyday wantrepreneur paralyzed behind their laptop, endlessly polishing logos, fearing awkward asks, and running low-stakes validation experiments. This universal human friction and kinetic momentum is the ideal match for Antidote's flat-vector Everyman rig and high-impact kinetic typography.
